title: Apify Python SDK - concept links input

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Docs page to collect the concept links from.

sectionPath.title: Section path
sectionPath.description: Only links whose path contains this substring are collected. Point it at another section (for example '/docs/guides/') to reuse the Actor for it.

maxLinks.title: Maximum links
maxLinks.description: Caps how many links are pushed to the dataset. Leave empty for all of them.
